attribution_limitations: The third-episode text says the prior two episodes also began with throat pain, while the first episode is described as anterior chest pain and the second as chest pain radiating from the lower ribs toward the throat.

The case text says high-intensity breath-holding was avoided after the first discharge without a duration; the abstract gives two weeks and the discussion says rigorous breath-hold training began soon after swimming resumed in the first two episodes. The accounts are compatible but the exact avoidance period after the second episode is not stated.
Incomplete healing of bronchial tissue is a proposed explanation, not a proven mechanism; no interval imaging confirmed radiographic resolution between episodes.
The source counts both three episodes of SPM and 'three recurrences' / 'three recurrent episodes'; the case text describes three episodes in total (first plus two recurrences).

Vital signs and examination were unremarkable; CT showed a small amount of mediastinal emphysema, and he was admitted for observation and pain control with resolution of pain and discharge on the third hospital day.
